notes.title: New Patch Available!
notes.content:
A new update has arrived! You can now continue exploring the world of Bleeding Deities after defeating the Teot Deity!

🌀 What's New?
After defeating the Teot Deity, a mysterious portal will appear in the same scene where the boss fight takes place. Entering this portal will return you to the Master’s Portal, allowing you to keep exploring the rest of the tribes, collect any missed collectables, 

⚠️ Important Note:
If you've already defeated the Teot Deity before this update, you'll need to defeat them again for the portal to appear.

🛠️ Coming Soon:
We’re currently working on accessibility options. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you to all our players for your continued support, feedback, and passion.
